messages.author: 6d75632cee2de0c4
messages.subject: glm.fit errors when using calculateDiffMeth
parts:
Hi again!

Any idea what would cause the model not to converge when calculating differential methylation? I'm getting the following error:

myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth_normalized)
Warning messages:
1: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 
2: glm.fit: algorithm did not converge 
3: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred 


N=64
context=CpG
Number of sites being tested w/ at least 10reads across all samples : 254,305

Please let me know what other information would be helpful.

Thanks,
Shannon

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] glm.fit errors when using calculateDiffMeth
parts:
I think you can ignore it. The warning usually occurs when the explanatory variable (being test or control) perfectly separates the response variable (methylation values). Which could be the case if methylation profiles differ drastically between test and control
cases.

Best,
Altuna
